lines.line: Pressure cooker — aluminium outer-lid, 2/3/5 L
lines.note: Generic outer-lid cookers sell thinly (Etro q4, Kayser q1); all branded Pigeon cookers are q0.

lines.line: Pressure cooker — stainless steel, induction base, 3–5 L
lines.note: Steel and induction-base cookers both present and sold, but in single digits.

lines.line: Pressure cooker — hard anodised, 5–8 L (large family)
lines.note: No hard-anodised SKU exists at all; only plain/induction 5 L cookers, and every one is out of stock.

lines.line: Institutional / canteen pressure cooker, 12–22 L
lines.note: 15 L, 25 L and 35 L cookers are catalogued but none ever sold or stocked.

lines.line: Cooker spares — gasket, safety valve, whistle/weight, handle
lines.searched: gasket, vent, whistl, safety valve, cooker
lines.note: Only two Hawkins spares listed (gasket, vent weight), both q0 and stk0 — a real gap in a captive market.

lines.line: Roti tawa — non-stick, 26–28 cm
Roti/paratha tawa — iron or cast iron, 25–30 cm
Dosa tawa — non-stick concave/flat, 30–33 cm
lines.note: One unit sold in 12m and nothing in stock; the Sunblaze dosa/concave tawas are all q0.

lines.line: Kadhai — non-stick with glass lid, 2–3 L / 24 cm
lines.note: The only non-stick kadai is q0; aluminium kadai with lid (0F8V, q8) sells instead.

lines.line: Kadhai — iron / cast iron, 24–28 cm
Kadhai/wok — stainless steel or triply, 2.5–3 L
lines.note: Plain steel kadai only; no triply, and the two induction-base kadais are q0.

lines.line: Fry pan / omelette pan — non-stick, 20–24 cm
lines.searched: fry pan, frypan, non stick, omlet
lines.note: Generic fry pans sell; the one explicitly non-stick fry pan (Blaze) is q0.

lines.line: Milk pan / sauce pan, 1–1.5 L (steel and non-stick)
Patila / handi / degchi — stainless steel with lid, 1–6 L
Bhagona / stock pot / langar vessel, 10–40 L
lines.searched: bhagona, degch, stock pot, langar, tope, patila, cauldron
lines.note: Only household-size patilas exist; no institutional 10–40 L vessel of any kind.

lines.line: Cooker separators / stackable inserts
lines.note: 'separat' returns only Steel Parat (dough tray) — no cooker separator or insert in the catalogue.

lines.line: Steamer — idli stand, dhokla plate, momo/appam pan
lines.note: Momo steamers sold one unit each and are out of stock; idli and appam makers are all q0.

lines.line: Milk boiler / double-bottom milk pot, 1–2 L
lines.note: Plain steel milk pots only — nothing described as a double-bottom milk boiler.

lines.line: Pressure pan / 2–3 L pan cooker
lines.best_match: Dev Bhumi Cooker 2 Ltr Induction Base
lines.note: No pan-shaped pressure pan exists; 2–3 L cookers cover the same small-household use.

lines.line: Tea pan / chai patila, 0.75–1.5 L
Chapati/roti box — insulated hot case, 1–1.5 L
lines.searched: chapati box, roti box, hot case, casserole
lines.note: Sold as casseroles, not as chapati boxes; the 1500 ml insulated Nayasa is the size that fits.

lines.line: Insulated casserole / hot pot, 2.5–5 L and gift sets
lines.note: Every sized SKU is 2 L or under and the casserole set (0DBS) is q0 — no 2.5–5 L or gift-set tier.

lines.line: Vacuum flask / thermos, 500 ml–1 L
Airpot / large thermos carafe, 1.9–3.5 L
lines.note: Largest vacuum flask in the catalogue is 1500 ml; no airpot or serving carafe exists.

lines.line: Thermosteel water bottle, 750 ml–1 L
lines.note: Insulated bottles are Nayasa/Speedex; no Milton Thermosteel-class SKU.

lines.line: Single-wall steel school water bottle, 600–900 ml
lines.note: Sells steadily (q42 and q39 on the top two) but every steel bottle SKU is currently at zero stock.

lines.line: Kids' character sipper bottle, 400–600 ml
lines.note: Plain sippers only — no licensed Disney/Marvel character prints; Milton Barbie SKU is q0.

lines.line: PET/plastic fridge bottle set, 1 L (set of 4–6)
lines.note: Both dedicated fridge bottles are q0; single 1 L plastic bottles (Nayasa Turtle q48) do sell.

lines.line: Copper water bottle / copper jug, 900 ml–1.5 L
lines.note: Copper Jug never sold and there is no copper bottle, though copper lota (q42) and glass (q60) sell well.

lines.line: Gym / hydration bottle and shaker, 1.2–2 L
lines.note: Shakers max out at 900 ml — no 1.2–2 L large-format hydration bottle.

lines.line: Steel tiffin / lunch box, 2–3 container
lines.note: Single steel containers and one steel lunch box sell; the only steel tiffin SKU (Vinod) is q0.

lines.line: Insulated leak-proof lunch box with bag, 3–4 containers
lines.best_match: Cello Lock Container 2 Pcs Set 900 Ml
lines.note: Leak-proof lock sets are 2-piece; only one insulated lunch box exists and no bag sets at all.

lines.line: Kids' compartment lunch box (plastic body / steel insert)
lines.note: Generic plastic lunch boxes only — none kid-branded and none with a steel insert.

lines.line: Tiffin carrier — 3–4 tier clip carrier
lines.note: The one steel tiffin SKU never sold; no clip or multi-tier carrier is catalogued.

lines.line: Steel thali / dinner plate, 10–13 inch (mess grade)
lines.note: Steel Thali and Steel Plate carry the line; all Pine thali variants are q0.

lines.line: Steel katori / bowl set (6 pc)
lines.note: Sold loose, not as 6-pc sets.

lines.line: Steel glass / tumbler, 250–350 ml (set of 6)
Cutlery — steel spoons, forks, teaspoons (pack of 6–12)
lines.note: Very low value (Rs1,100 a year on the top spoon) for a line that should repeat constantly in messes.

lines.line: Cooking tools — palta/turner, ladle, chimta (tongs), masher, skimmer
lines.note: Chimta, palta, wooden turners/ladles/skimmers all present; no masher found.

lines.line: Chakla-belan, roti press, puri press
lines.note: Wooden chakla and belan only — no roti press or puri press, and no marble chakla.

lines.line: Sieve/chalni (atta), colander, rice washer
Kitchen knife, peeler, scissors, chopping board
lines.note: Knife, peeler and board covered; no kitchen scissors surfaced.

lines.line: Hand chopper, grater/slicer, squeezer and small gadgets
lines.note: Choppers and graters sell; all three Pigeon Handy Choppers are q0.

lines.line: Masala dabba (7-compartment spice box) and spice jars
Steel airtight storage jars / dabba set (300 ml–2 L)
lines.note: One generic steel dabba line does all the volume (q134); every other steel box SKU is q0.

lines.line: Plastic airtight kitchen container set, 1–5 L (atta/rice/dal)
Grain drum / large canister, 10–30 kg
lines.note: Plastic canisters up to 22 L only; no steel or rat-proof grain drum in the catalogue.

lines.line: Microwave/oven-safe glass containers and borosilicate bowls
lines.note: Microwave casserole and both Purefit glass bowls are q0; no borosilicate brand at all.

lines.line: Jug — plastic/steel 1.5–2 L, and insulated jug 2–3 L
lines.note: Plastic, steel and one insulated jug all sell, but only in single digits each.

lines.line: Water storage container with tap, 10–20 L
lines.best_match: Nayasa Water Jug 22 Ltr Cool King
lines.searched: with tap, dispenser, camper, water tank, jug
lines.note: The 22 L Cool King and the 4 L Disuri carrier are listed and stocked but have never sold.

lines.line: Oil dispenser / ghee container / oil can, 500 ml–1 L
lines.note: One unbranded dispenser sells; all three Nayasa oil dispensers are q0.

lines.line: Baby feeding steel — bowl-spoon set, suction plate, sipper cup, food flask
lines.note: Sipper cups and one steel feeder bottle sell; no bowl-spoon set, suction plate or food flask.

lines.line: Dinner set — opalware/melamine 18–27 pc, plus cup & saucer set
lines.searched: dinner set, opal, melamine, cup set, crockery set
lines.note: Cup sets sell (q24); every 18–27 pc dinner set SKU is q0 and no opalware brand is listed.

lines.line: Ceramic mug / tea cup set (6 pc)
lines.note: Rs52,565 a year on one mug SKU — the strongest performer in the whole category.

lines.line: Glass tumbler set and glass jug
lines.note: Tumblers and 6-pc sets sell; there is no glass jug — every jug in stock is plastic or steel.

lines.line: Gas lighter, oven mitts / pot holder, apron
lines.note: Gas lighter and apron both sell well; no oven mitts or pot holders exist.

lines.line: Dish drainer rack / plate stand / kitchen shelf organiser
lines.note: Vessel stands and a generic kitchen rack sell; the actual dish-drainer and utensil racks are q0.

lines.line: Electric kettle, 1–1.5 L
lines.note: Deep range and the best-selling appliance line here (Skyline q15).

lines.line: Electric lunch box / hot case (roti-food warmer)
lines.note: One unit sold in 12m, nothing in stock, and the Nayasa Electromate is q0.

lines.line: Clay / earthen cookware — handi, tawa, kulhad
lines.note: Only a decorative Mitti Lota (q17) and Amul Kulhad Kulfi ice cream — no clay handi, tawa or kulhads.
